The declaration moves from `no` to `no (narrowing)`, the trigger the dispatch set: the html/mjml face of `service-messaging`'s notification renderer now escapes every hole. So an existing authored html or mjml `sys_notification_template` row whose body relied on a payload value rendering as markup renders differently after this change. In-tree reach is zero (no such row, and no producer that pre-renders HTML), and rows stored in deployments cannot be measured from here. The change ships as a BREAKING minor under the amended 「甲」 (`6303865025`), with a `!` title, its ADR-0087 disposition and the full dogfood battery on the final head. It owes a contract-tier review before the queue.
